meta.inspection: All 25 images individually inspected using view_image at phone-like landscape display scale. No keys, source or other judges read. Own prior packet images hashed only to preserve exact unchanged anchors.
meta.blinding_limitations: Repeated controls and visual families recognizable. Sci-fi resembles StarCraft and battlefield references Company of Heroes; tactical title uncertain. No presumed iteration benefit.

view-01.png.evidence: Service compound, dirt lanes, muted trees and roof walls structure base.
view-01.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player overlaps roof and contacts heavy. Unchanged anchor.

view-02.png.evidence: Wet reflections, rain, tracer and smoke unify rich rubble/mud.
view-02.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Dark units merge with terrain. Unchanged reference.

view-03.png.evidence: Metal ships and cool rock contrast with layered bright explosion.
view-03.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Blast obscures units; purple forms merge with foliage. Unchanged reference.

view-04.png.evidence: Outlined player separates from grass/rocks; muted trees coherent.
view-04.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Flat central grass and heavy repeating tree shadows. Unchanged anchor.

view-05.png.evidence: Clear outlined player, continuous tan panels, raised island and wake.
view-05.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Uniform deck light and paired wake limit realism. Unchanged anchor.

view-06.png.evidence: Broad apron, service lanes and raised blue roofs establish functional base; dark blue ocean adds material depth.
view-06.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Blue player still merges with blue hangar. Noisy grass, abrupt shore segments and strong tree contacts remain; water realism exceeds polygonal land style.

view-07.png.evidence: Dark ocean separates pale planes; deck panels, raised island and shaded hull give depth. Tiny orange impact flares read.
view-07.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Planes on tan deck overlap markings; repeated wake puffs and broad shadows remain. High-frequency water competes with small sprites.

view-08.png.evidence: Compound, dirt lanes, roof walls and muted trees create rich base structure.
view-08.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player/roof overlap, tiny service blocks and heavy shadows persist. Unchanged anchor.

view-09.png.evidence: Coherent tan deck and dark rim with outline and trailing wake.
view-09.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Pale plane/deck overlap and repeated dot particles. Unchanged anchor.

view-10.png.evidence: Outlined lone plane, dark top bars, continuous deck and wake clear.
view-10.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Soft edges and uniform light limit depth. Unchanged anchor.

view-11.png.evidence: Pale plane silhouettes contrast against dark textured sea; orange impacts and thin smoke have defined forms.
view-11.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Many equal orange flecks and crossing planes fragment attention. Player near bow remains crowded; smoke rosettes and repeated wake puffs look stamped.

view-12.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Beach is abrupt narrow strip with segmented upper transitions; flat ground and heavy circular tree contacts contrast with detailed sea. Soft edges limit precision.

view-13.png.evidence: Dark water frames light carrier and planes; large controls and compact orange flares remain readable.
view-13.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Soft aircraft edges merge into deck marks. Water is busier than quieter retained controls; wake has repeated oval segments.

view-14.png.evidence: Detailed deck, island and rim with stable HUD and wake.
view-14.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Plane occlusion and repetitive smoke dots remain. Unchanged anchor.

view-15.png.evidence: Crisp plane outline, dimensional rocks and tree crowns; varied ocean adds surface depth.
view-15.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Fine water texture contrasts with simple beach and flat grass. Coast still looks a cut edge with an abrupt stepped color transition at top.

view-16.png.evidence: Sparse composition, dark hull edge, readable raised island and light player silhouette on sea.
view-16.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player overlaps tan deck at bow; repetitive segmented wake and soft carrier edges. Dark detailed ocean lacks corresponding deck lighting complexity.

view-17.png.evidence: Service apron and roads structure base; dark sea provides a clear coastline boundary.
view-17.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player nearly merges with middle blue hangar; grass uniform, tree shadows heavy, coastline sharply segmented. Fallback softness reduces material separation.

view-18.png.evidence: Continuous tan deck, narrow rim, island shadow and wake coherent.
view-18.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Pale aircraft on pale deck crowded; limited side lighting. Unchanged anchor.

view-19.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Units merge with ground/haze. Unchanged reference.

view-20.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Tiny units/text demanding at phone size. Unchanged reference.

view-21.png.evidence: Continuous panel deck, raised island, narrow rim and clear wake; outlined player visible.
view-21.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Pale aircraft merge with runway marks; paired wake simple. Unchanged anchor.

view-22.png.evidence: Warm shadowed market with produce/props and traceable colored routes.
view-22.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Small brown figures merge into surroundings. Unchanged reference.

view-23.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Numerous equal fire specks, smoke dots and overlapping planes obscure priorities; lower-resolution edges reduce separation on deck.

view-24.png.evidence: Outlined plane, muted trees, rocks and partial compound create coherent coast.
view-24.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Flat noisy ground and simple shore; repeated dark tree contacts. Unchanged anchor.

view-25.png.evidence: Raised island, deck seams and dark hull establish carrier volume against deeper-looking ocean.
view-25.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player partly merges with runway marks; wake remains repeated puffs and sea fine texture competes with more schematic vessel shading.

general_next_priorities: Reduce competition between detailed dark ocean and schematic vessel/land shading; retain useful dark-value contrast.
Give player consistent separation over hangars and deck, where blue/gray merges into roofs and markings.
Differentiate major hits from equal small orange flecks and reduce dense overlap interference.
Blend shore transitions and add purposeful land relief rather than finer uniform noise.
Replace repetitive puff-chain wakes with connected irregular foam.
